system.name: 33GOD
system.summary: Event-driven agentic development platform composed from independently versioned repos and coordinated by this control plane.

domains.name: Bloodbank Core Bus
domains.summary: The NATS JetStream event bus, its CloudEvents contract, schemas and the Candystore audit store.

domains.name: Integration Plane
domains.summary: n8n workflows and webhooks that turn outside events (Plane tickets, journals) into bus events.

domains.name: Agent Fleet Runtime
domains.summary: The Hermes gateway and agent profiles, plus the hook pipeline that reports what agents are doing.

domains.name: Observability
domains.summary: Metrics, alerts, exporters and daily reports that show platform health.

domains.name: Project Tooling
domains.summary: Project registry, skill catalog, shared project scaffolding and MCP hub used by every repo.

domains.name: Voice Pipeline
domains.summary: HeyMa: dictation, transcription, intake and text-to-speech.

domains.name: Enrichment and Memory
domains.summary: LLM-touching services: embeddings, turn annotation, cost tracking, agent memory and LLM routing.

domains.name: Orchestration and Apps
domains.summary: Ticket dispatch (Krebs), workforce (Flume), ticket CLI (Pilot) and the Holocene operator app.

domains.name: Scheduling
domains.summary: Candybar, the single clock that fires every recurring job.

domains.name: Operator Desktop
domains.summary: Tools that live only on the operator's workstation: workspace, attention, voice relay, crank.

domains.name: Client Surface
domains.summary: What external clients touch: the Genesis liaison, client portal and billing.

domains.name: Shared Infra
domains.summary: Third-party infrastructure the platform runs on: databases, proxy, tunnels, secrets, object store.

people.name: Operator
people.summary: The solo owner who runs the platform, steers agents and reviews results.

people.name: Client
people.summary: Someone who leases a 33GOD agent and talks to it through their Genesis desk.

people.name: Mirror-site operator
people.summary: A collaborator who runs a mirrored copy of the platform on their own machine.

people.name: Voice user
people.summary: Someone dictating or sending voice memos into the platform.

components.name: AutomaticAI LLM gateway
components.summary: One front door that routes every model request to the right provider.
components.role_in_system: Without it agents and memory have no model to call.
components.runtime: Not on big-chungus docker (only exited newapi-postgres/redis from 4 weeks ago). It is a customized NewAPI fork running on a cloud VM (compose.cloud.yml: new-api, postgres, redis, caddy, cloudflared; api-direct.automaticai.io resolves to 44.196.227.90, /v1/models returns 401 as expected, api.automaticai.io via Cloudflare). Source repo is /home/delorenj/code/client-portal/gateway (ops/routes.json owns route catalog; ops/cloud/vm-health.py). Host-side newapi-* systemd units/timers are operational jobs driven by Candybar. Hermes config points at https://api-direct.automaticai.io/v1

components.name: AAI LLM observability
components.summary: Collects and reshapes gateway usage logs into metrics.
components.role_in_system: Without it model spend and errors are not charted.

components.name: Activity report
components.summary: Writes the periodic what-shipped update for each project and audience.
components.role_in_system: Turns a window of events, commits and tickets into one update per audience.
components.runtime: skill scripts (run.sh -> ar cli): digest, lint, render, emit one bloodbank.project.activity.recorded per audience

components.name: agent-hooks publisher
components.summary: Turns raw agent hooks into contract-valid events and publishes them.
components.role_in_system: Owns the envelope builder and validator every producer reuses.

components.name: Agent pad
components.summary: A Holocene screen for talking to and watching individual agents.
components.role_in_system: Per-agent operator view.
components.runtime: Two docker containers agent-pad-web (nginx) and agent-pad-upload (python, 127.0.0.1:8698) from /home/delorenj/docker/stacks/websites/agent-pad, plus holocene-pad-roster.service which is inactive between runs because the Candybar job holocene-pad-roster (*/2) fires it

components.name: Agents registry
components.summary: A file listing every agent, its role and where it works.
components.role_in_system: The roster the gateway and tools read; Flume is its only writer.

components.name: artifact-sidecar
components.summary: Captures files agents produce and links them to the events that made them.
components.role_in_system: Without it artifacts are not attached to event history.
components.runtime: systemd user unit bloodbank-artifact-sidecar.service (python3.14 bloodbank/services/artifact-sidecar/main.py), active. Consumes bloodbank.evt.agent.tool.completed and bloodbank.evt.conversation.turn.completed, publishes bloodbank.evt.project.artifact.created; sha256 content-addressed store + sqlite ledger. Paired with artifact-vault-projector which writes into the vault

components.name: artifact-vault-projector
components.summary: Writes captured agent artifacts into the operator's notes vault, organized by project and date.
components.role_in_system: Second half of the artifact pipeline; without it artifacts exist on the bus but never show up in the vault.

components.name: Agent State Machine
components.summary: Keeps a live picture of what each agent process is doing right now.
components.role_in_system: Holocene and desktop painters read agent state from it.
components.runtime: Also two always-on painters: asm-orcapaint.service and asm-tabpaint.service (paint ASM state onto Orca worktree cards and zellij tab bar). asm-sweep.timer fires every ~15s (asmctl sweep). Host redis-server 127.0.0.1:6379 exists (pid 3803)

components.name: Apicurio schema registry
components.summary: A schema registry meant for looking up event schemas at runtime.
components.role_in_system: Planned read side for schemas; nothing depends on it today.

components.name: EventCatalog
components.summary: A browsable website listing every event type for humans.
components.role_in_system: Discovery aid only; loss affects no runtime flow.

components.name: bb operator CLI
components.summary: Command-line tool to check the contract, emit, trace and replay bus events.
components.role_in_system: Operators and agents use it to learn legal event names and debug flows.

components.name: Dapr sidecars
components.summary: Dapr sidecars that deliver bus events to Candystore and the enricher.
components.role_in_system: Subscribe-side delivery for Candystore and enricher; placement service is idle.
components.runtime: Correct container set, but names/projects are candystore-daprd, enricher-daprd and bloodbank-dapr-placement, all in compose project 33god-platform (33god-platform/compose.yaml:61,134,319). Repo should be 33god-platform (and candystore/dapr-components, 33god-platform/enricher/dapr-components), not bloodbank/compose/components. Enricher durable consumer enricher-events: ackWait 300s, maxAckPending 32, deliverPolicy new

components.name: bb-hook
components.summary: A tiny command each coding agent runs on every hook to hand the event to hook-hub.
components.role_in_system: Entry point of all agent activity reporting.

components.name: Bloodbank NATS broker
components.summary: The NATS JetStream server that stores and delivers bus messages.
components.role_in_system: The physical broker; if it is down every publish fails.
components.runtime: docker container bloodbank-nats (nats:2.10-alpine, -js) in compose project 33god-platform (33god-platform/compose.yaml:14); ports 4222 and 8222 on 0.0.0.0. Streams live: BLOODBANK_EVENTS (1,166,299 msgs), BLOODBANK_COMMANDS (210), plus GIB_EVENTS (excluded game)

components.name: Bloodbank
components.summary: The event backbone: every service publishes and listens for CloudEvents on it.
components.role_in_system: Without it no service can tell another that anything happened; dispatch, audit and alerts all stop.
components.runtime: No live container belongs to compose project 'bloodbank'. bloodbank/compose/docker-compose.yml is a self-hosted sandbox (bloodbank-postgres, daprd-subscribe, heartbeat-*, apicurio, eventcatalog) that is not running. The live bus (NATS, dapr placement, candystore, enricher) comes from 33god-platform/compose.yaml; bloodbank-owned live pieces are host systemd units (hook-hub, artifact-sidecar, artifact-vault-projector, target-watch) and separate per-service compose projects (ntfy-router, turn-enricher, cost-bridge, farm-command-bridge)

public_card.title: Event Backbone
public_card.promise: CloudEvents over NATS/Dapr with canonical schemas and provider-neutral agent hooks.

components.name: Candybar
components.summary: The single clock that starts every recurring job on time.
components.role_in_system: Without it no recurring work runs, including Krebs dispatch and the daily report.

public_card.title: Cron Framework
public_card.promise: Schedule and meter jobs through Bloodbank with a reversible migration ledger.

components.name: Candybar host executor
components.summary: Runs scheduled commands on the host when the clock fires.
components.role_in_system: Without it exec and systemd jobs never execute.

components.name: Candybar steward
components.summary: Host-side role that keeps Candybar's registrations and units in order.
components.role_in_system: Steward contract role; with candybar-unit-holder it keeps started units loaded for accounting (AD-18).
components.runtime: systemd user units candybar-steward.service and candybar-unit-holder.service

components.name: Candybar watchdog timer
components.summary: A tiny timer that pages if Candybar itself stops.
components.role_in_system: The only allowed timer outside Candybar (AD-22).

components.name: Candystore
components.summary: Saves a permanent copy of every bus event so history can be searched later.
components.role_in_system: The audit trail; reports, Holocene and the enricher read it.

public_card.title: Event History
public_card.promise: Queryable event/session memory for the whole pipeline.

components.name: Client portal
components.summary: The automaticai.io website and the internal operator portal for services, accounts, statements and invoices.
components.role_in_system: Client visibility.

components.name: Cloudflare
components.summary: Hosts tunnels, Workers and Workers AI models.
components.role_in_system: Edge for public URLs, the Genesis desk Worker and Clairic extraction.

components.name: Cloudflare tunnels
components.summary: Outbound tunnels that publish selected homelab services at public URLs.
components.role_in_system: How clients and Workers reach Genesis and other services without opening ports.

components.name: CommonProject
components.summary: Shared scaffolding every project starts from.
components.role_in_system: Keeps new repos consistent.

components.name: cost-bridge
components.summary: Takes in billing cost records over HTTPS, puts them on the bus and replays them into the AutomaticAI portal until each one is confirmed saved.
components.role_in_system: Without it spend is invisible to billing and reports.

components.name: Crank
components.summary: Nudges idle agent panes to keep work moving when the operator is away.
components.role_in_system: Momentum while unattended.
components.runtime: Driven by Candybar jobs crank-beat (*/5, 1986 runs/7d, hermes-agent runner) and crank-watchdog (*/15), typing into panes via ~/.local/bin/zcrank-send; hook-hub also has crank-tag and crank_keys_guard handlers. Not desktop-only

components.name: Curator
components.summary: Sorts and files incoming documents and folders automatically.
components.role_in_system: Keeps intake folders organized; loss leaves files unsorted.

components.name: DeLoNET daily report
components.summary: A once-a-day summary of what happened across the platform.
components.role_in_system: The operator's single daily digest.
components.runtime: Confirmed: Candybar dev-journal-nightly 0 6 * * * (reportctl run+verify then distribute to vault/S3/Slack) and dev-journal-ensure-nightly 15 6 * * * enabled; reads Candystore at http://127.0.0.1:8683 (collectors/turn_facts.py, dev_activity.py). dev-journal-reconcile.service (hourly replay) is currently failed

components.name: Deckard
components.summary: A Stream Deck control surface for the operator's terminal workspace.
components.role_in_system: Operator awareness; reads attention events.

components.name: DeLoNET Director read model
components.summary: A read-only API over company capacity and contract data.
components.role_in_system: Read model for director/company views; loopback only.

components.name: DeLoSIP ring bridge
components.summary: Makes the phone ring loudly for verified incoming calls.
components.role_in_system: Turns a signed telephony callback into a guaranteed ring and a notification.
components.runtime: systemd user unit delosip-ring-bridge.service on loopback :18746; the canonical n8n workflow forwards Telnyx's signed bytes to it

components.name: Earshot
components.summary: Drop a sound file into a channel and the phone plays it.
components.role_in_system: The last hop from any agent or job to the operator's ears.
components.runtime: systemd user unit earshot-folder.service (earshot watch) mirrors ~/Earshot/<channel>/ into the earshot bucket; Android app sh.delo.earshot polls and plays

components.name: Candystore enricher
components.summary: Adds search embeddings to stored events so they can be found by meaning.
components.role_in_system: Without it semantic search over history stops.

components.name: Bloodbank event contract and schemas
components.summary: The rulebook and 214 JSON schemas that say how every event is named and shaped.
components.role_in_system: Without it producers invent names nobody consumes; validate.py enforces it.
components.runtime: files in repo; enforced at publish by agent-hooks validate.py and bb emit

components.name: farm-command-bridge
components.summary: A signed web entry point that turns invoice requests from the portal and bank webhooks into billing commands on the bus.
components.role_in_system: Feeds Milkshake billing with work done.

components.name: Flume
components.summary: Hires, onboards and reviews agents and keeps the roster.
components.role_in_system: The only writer of the agents registry.

public_card.title: The Workforce
public_card.promise: One place that hires an agent, seats it, and tells you honestly how it is doing.

components.name: Flume access facade
components.summary: The front door that lets Cloudflare Access-authenticated employees reach agent identity data.
components.role_in_system: Origin behind identity.delo.sh; verifies the Cloudflare Access JWT and refuses anything else.
components.runtime: systemd user unit flume-access.service (flume access serve), 0.0.0.0:18791; Traefik host identity-origin.delo.sh

components.name: Genesis client liaison
components.summary: The agent clients talk to about their projects.
components.role_in_system: Client-facing front door.

components.name: Genesis desk Worker
components.summary: Public web desk on Cloudflare where clients reach Genesis.
components.role_in_system: Client entry point.

components.role_in_system: Smoke-test domain event for the Dapr path; not required at runtime.
components.runtime: compose sandbox only (bloodbank-heartbeat-tick, bloodbank-heartbeat-recorder); no container running

components.name: Hermes Bloodbank platform plugin

components.role_in_system: Without it Krebs dispatch commands are never picked up.

components.name: Hermes Dashboard
components.summary: A web dashboard for the whole Hermes agent runtime.
components.role_in_system: Operator window onto the single Hermes install; separate from Holocene.

components.name: Hermes Fleet
components.summary: The set of AI agents (project managers, directors, specialists) that do the platform's work.
components.role_in_system: Without it tickets are dispatched to nobody.

public_card.title: Managed AI Worker Fleet

components.name: Hermes gateway
components.summary: The one long-running process that hosts every agent profile and their chat bots.
components.role_in_system: A restart pauses every agent; it is the fleet's only runtime.

components.name: HeyMa

components.role_in_system: Without it voice input and spoken output stop.

public_card.title: Voice Interface
public_card.promise: Talk to the pipeline and capture meetings/transcripts as events.

components.name: Hindsight
components.summary: Long-term memory where agents store and recall project facts.

components.name: Holocene
components.summary: The operator's web app showing agents, schedules and events in one place.
components.role_in_system: The main human window into the platform.

public_card.title: Mission Control
public_card.promise: Live operational view of agents, events, and platform health.

components.name: Holocene API

components.role_in_system: Operator UI.

components.name: Intake

components.role_in_system: Artifact and file storage.
